products.limit_basis_notes: Benefit limits are per person unless stated otherwise. Cancellation/Amendment limits (selected amounts) apply per policy. Maximum liability collectively for Sections 14, 15 and 16 is $45,000 on this plan.
products.pre_existing_medical_conditions_summary: Claims relating to Existing Medical Conditions are excluded unless approved. A list of conditions is automatically included if criteria met (e.g., Acne, ADHD, mild Asthma under 60, Hypertension/hypercholesterolaemia with stability criteria). Other conditions require online health assessment and additional premium if accepted. Undiagnosed/under investigation conditions cannot be covered.
products.pregnancy_cover_summary: Limited cover for serious, unexpected complications up to 23 weeks 6 days’ gestation. No cover for childbirth or newborn care. If pregnant at Relevant Time and multiple/assisted conception or prior complications exist, assessment and approval with additional premium required.
products.non_traveller_health_rules: Cover for Relative/business partner health events only if, at Relevant Time, they were not recently hospitalised, not in aged/residential care, living independently without home care, not awaiting tests/surgery, no drug/alcohol addiction, and no terminal illness; otherwise a combined cap of $1,000 applies across the policy.

included_activities.activity: Scuba diving up to 30m (with certification or diving school/instructor)
included_activities.conditions: No professional participation; reasonable care and safety equipment required.

optional_activity_cover.activity: Rafting grades 4–5, rock climbing up to 4,000m

optional_activity_cover.conditions: Guided for heli; no racing/professional; no PL cover for snowmobile.

excluded_activities.exclusion: Hunting; rodeo; BASE jumping; hang gliding; motocross; freestyle BMX; running with the bulls; professional sports; mountaineering using guides/ropes/oxygen; trekking >6,000m; ice climbing beyond allowed; scuba diving >50m or >30m without certification/instructor
excluded_activities.evidence: p14 Activities We do not cover; p49 General exclusions 22.

products.rental_vehicle_excess_conditions: Cover applies when you are the nominated driver and comprehensive insurance is in place; excludes damage when driven on unsealed surfaces; excludes administration/loss-of-use fees. Motorcycle/moped rental excess covered only if Motorcycle add-on purchased.
products.luggage_conditions: No cover for valuables checked-in unless forced by security; items unattended in vehicles not covered overnight and limited to $500 per item/$2,000 total during daylight if forced entry to concealed compartment; report theft/loss within 7 days; proof of ownership required; drones not covered while in use; sporting equipment not covered while in use.

general_exclusions.exclusion: Known events or circumstances at Relevant Time
Do Not Travel advice (related to claim subject)

products.travel_warning_and_sanctions_rules: No cover if travelling to a destination with Do Not Travel advice relevant to the claim; sanctions and embargo restrictions apply; restricted countries include Cuba, Iran, Syria, North Korea and specified regions of Ukraine.
products.claims_process_summary: Submit claim online or by post with original supporting documents. Notify police/transport/accommodation within 7 days for theft/loss. Advise insurer and lodge a completed claim within 60 days of return date. Assessment response within 10 working days after receiving the claim or further information.
products.emergency_assistance_details: 24/7 assistance. Call +61 2 8907 5246 from anywhere; toll-free numbers available from USA 1833 5444 806, Canada 1833 907 8111, UK 0808 234 9722, NZ 0800 462 640. Contact as soon as possible if hospitalised, medical expenses exceed $2,000, or returning early.
products.premium_factors: Destination/area of travel; departure date and trip duration; age; plan (Comprehensive vs Essential/Basic/Domestic); selected excess; Cruise cover; selected cancellation amount; added cover for Existing Medical Conditions or pregnancy; optional add-ons.

data._document_notes: Benefits and limits are drawn primarily from the Benefits tables (pp.4–6) and corresponding policy sections. The Domestic benefits table text was partially OCR garbled; corroborating limits were taken from the policy wording sections (pp.32–41) where needed. Maximum trip duration options for Annual Multi‑Trip are not specified in the PDS and are left unfilled. Cruise cover is an optional add‑on available only for International plans and is required to cover multi‑night ocean/sea cruises; domestic cruising is handled via destination selection and not a Cruise add‑on. COVID‑19 cover varies by section and optional purchase per PDS Section 18.
